name: bakbak-mcp
description: Text to speech in Hindi, 12 more Indian languages and English, saved as audio files on your computer.
long_description: The official Bakbak MCP server. Ask Claude to read text aloud in Hindi, Marathi, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Assamese, Gujarati, Nepali, Malayalam, Tamil, Punjabi or English, and it saves a WAV or MP3 file in your Documents/Bakbak folder. Choose from Bakbak's voices, change the speed, and synthesize long texts (up to 50,000 characters) into one file. You need a Bakbak API key from https://bakbak.getraya.app; synthesis uses your Bakbak credits.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Convert text to natural speech and save it as an audio file (uses Bakbak credits).

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List Bakbak voices by language, model and name (free).
